name: Gondwana
description: The southern supercontinent Jambhudweep was fused to in deep time, before the seas divided it.
notes: Named as the setting of the Fang vs Scale wars. Canon had no entity for it, which is why the source document filed that event under `region_shattered_sea` -- a region that exists, and is not where the war happened. A place canon can point at is the fix. Its survivors are Jambhudweep's too, and nowhere else: the Permian and Triassic relicts, now critically rare; the giant amphibians; the crocodylomorphs, which Jambhudweep has in more shapes than anywhere; the first freshwater whales; and the giant flightless birds. Canon marks them `landmasses: [jambhudweepa, gondwana]`, and means to author more of each.
